# Flooring Hub

> Independent flooring installation and refinishing company serving the Raleigh-Durham (Triangle) area of North Carolina. Owner-operated by Tom Smith, on-site on every project.

## Canonical facts
- Website: https://www.flooringhubnc.com
- Phone: (330) 573-0370
- Email: tsmith@flooringhubnc.com
- Request a free in-home estimate: https://www.flooringhubnc.com/#quote
- Service area: https://www.flooringhubnc.com/#service-area
- FAQ: https://www.flooringhubnc.com/#faq

## Services
Hardwood flooring installation, luxury vinyl plank (LVP) installation, laminate flooring installation, carpet installation, and hardwood floor refinishing. Floor leveling is included as part of installation prep when a subfloor needs it, not sold as a standalone service. This site does not list prices; ask for a free in-home estimate.

## About
Tom Smith, Owner & Master Craftsman, has over 25 years of hands-on flooring experience. Flooring Hub is not a franchise and does not use a rotating installation crew -- Tom is on-site and accountable for every project himself.

## Service area
Raleigh, Durham, Chapel Hill, Cary, Apex, Garner, Clayton, Fuquay-Varina, Wake Forest, Holly Springs, Pittsboro, Hillsborough, and Zebulon, North Carolina. If a property is nearby but not on this list, call to ask -- the website does not claim coverage it hasn't confirmed.

## Getting a quote
- Fill out the free estimate form at https://www.flooringhubnc.com/#quote. Tom reviews every request himself and usually responds within 24 hours to schedule a free in-home consultation.
- Or call (330) 573-0370 or email tsmith@flooringhubnc.com directly.
- Estimates are free, in-home, and no-obligation.

## Frequently asked questions
### What types of flooring does Flooring Hub specialize in?
Hardwood, laminate, luxury vinyl plank (LVP), and carpet -- plus the prep those jobs need, like leveling. Residential homes in the Triangle.

### Do you offer floor leveling?
If a subfloor needs it, Tom includes leveling as part of prep. It is not a standalone service listed on this site.

### How do I get a quote?
Call (330) 573-0370 or email tsmith@flooringhubnc.com to schedule a free in-home or on-site consultation. No obligation.

### Why is professional installation important?
Professional installation ensures quality, longevity, and a flawless finish, following national standards and manufacturer guidelines to protect the warranty and the investment.

### Can you handle complex flooring projects?
Tom handles custom trim, staircases, moisture mitigation, and challenging layouts himself -- not a rotating crew.

### What areas do you service?
The greater Raleigh-Durham area; see the service area list above for all covered cities.
